title: A completed one-time adjustment must not read as pending (the completion note is the third-newest entry of an older record)
turns: Is the upside call calendar adjustment on the IRA 5800 calendar still pending?
expected: No. It was done on 10/27: two Nov 6/10 5870 call calendars were added for 19.40 debit and filled. It was a one-time adjustment, so it is used up and nothing is pending.
pass_if: says the upside adjustment is already done (on 10/27)
does not present adding upside call calendars as a step still to take
fail_if: says or implies it is still pending or waiting on a market move
says he can't tell, without giving the 10/27 completion
